question: Which of the following is the oldest stock exchange in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**BSE.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__** 

__
 
• The BSE __(Bombay stock exchange) is not only India's oldest stock exchange but it is the **oldest stock exchange in Asia**. It is the largest stock exchange in India and is operating out of **Mumbai, Maharashtra**.
